author_note: Written before scripts/run_h53_holdout.py was executed for the first time. It covers (a) the top geological candidate H53-A from the 2026-10-08 slate, (b) the H53-F emission operating-point sweep on cached fold fields, and (c) the regeneration build of the promoted H-H/H-D procedure under the brief's constraints (new seeds, q10 confinement, all-finite [0,1] encoding with zeros outside the footprint).

instrument.folds: six contiguous 3x3 spatial blocks of the visible catalogue; 12 px training buffer; block = fold truth; rest of catalogue = known/masked
instrument.emission: STE ridge scales 1/2/3.5 px, line length 9, continuity exponent 0.35, greedy spacing 2.4 px
instrument.stage1: fold-specific rank-space strain-budget deficit over 10 km tiles (Kreemer et al. 2000 Eq. 3), held-out trace rows removed; approved = tiles at/above q10; 100% Stage-2 confinement; lift <= 1.5; approved area >= 2/3

h53_a.features: 6 crest/ridge responses of the rank-space geodetic residuals (q(observed 2.5 km tile mean) - q(fault tensor II 2.5 km tile)) for geod_2ndinv, geod_shearrate, geod_dilaterate at sigma 1.5 and 4.0 px
promotion_requires_all_of: fresh ungated baseline reproduces frozen mean within 1e-5
paired q10-gated delta > 0 with >= 4/6 folds positive
100% candidate points inside q10 approved tiles
h53_a.on_failure: NOT PROMOTED; no H53-A TIFF; no slot consumed

h53_f.arms: ratio in {2.96, 3.47} x flank in {2.0, 2.24} px on cached fresh fold blend fields; STE L9 w=0.35 s=2.4; q10-gated
h53_f.adoption_rule: adopt a non-default point only if it beats the (3.47, 2.0) gated mean by >= +0.0020 with >= 4/6 folds positive; otherwise build at ratio 3.47, flank 2.0 px, 44,069 dots

regeneration_build.procedure: H-H/H-D fixed 50/50 probability blend fitted on the full published catalogue, STE L9 w=0.35 spacing 2.4 emission, flank 2.0 px, all points inside the full-data q10 approved tiles, mass from the H53-F decision (default 44,069 dots = 3.47 x 12,700 planning |G|)
regeneration_build.uniqueness: new seeds -> new belief fields -> new dot support; pre-write support gate against every locally held prior (21 pinned family references + local priors + previous downloads + archive); limits Jaccard 0.50 / containment 0.60
regeneration_build.encoding: float32, EPSG:32611, exact template transform and shape, all cells finite in [0,1], zeros outside the footprint, no NoData tag (direct fix for the portal 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]' hazard, IR-51-21)
regeneration_build.validation_requirement: a fresh paired six-fold receipt for the exact built geometry (q10-gated blend) is required before the manifest may mark the file as the upload candidate; the receipt reports the measured compliance cost vs the frozen ungated best honestly

claims_policy: No organizer score, portal acceptance, or leaderboard improvement is claimed from any local number. A local proxy promotion licenses packaging and labelling, never a score claim.
